limits: One deterministic group-disjoint split, not confidence intervals, writer/batch independence, time-forward testing or a deployment benchmark
Greedy CART and floating weakest-link pruning are established methods, not globally optimal tree learning or exact certificates
Feature duplicates stay together, including target conflicts; near duplicates and missing batch identifiers remain unresolved
Squared error treats ordinal scores as numeric and penalizes large errors; other losses answer different questions

protocol.alpha_units: SSE / number of fitting rows + alpha * leaves; alpha in target-score-squared units per leaf
protocol.selection: Minimum validation MSE over full weakest-link path; exact ties prefer fewer leaves; no refit
protocol.source_target: Ordinal expert quality score treated as numeric; not a price, safety or causal target
protocol.split: Sort SHA-256 of canonical parsed feature values; first floor(60%) unique groups fit, next through floor(80%) validation, rest test
